newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products gain, prompt fuel pressured.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products gain, prompt fuel pressured.

text.p: NWE oil products were over $1 a tonne firmer on Wednesday, largely because of futures strength late on Wednesday, with only limited buying, dealers said.

Gasoline barges were about $2 higher after NYMEX unleaded futures added over one cent per gallon on Wednesday. One eurograde barge traded at $210 fob Rotterdam for first half June delivery. Both early June physical and June swaps were quoted in the range $209/$211 by late morning.
Heating oil barges were also $2 a tonne firmer as IPE June futures gained. Offers, however, came off slightly, to IPE June +$2.25 fob Rotterdam as buyers remained uninterested.
High sulphur fuel oil traded at $81 fob Rotterdam early for delivery by the weekend, but soon moved up about $1/$2 to a range of $82/$84 for end of May lifting.
Some traders still sought to shift very prompt product and seemed willing to sell it for $82.
In Flushing, one barge traded for $83 fob.
